third_party_evaluations.summary: Expert Azure infrastructure design with identity, governance, and zero-trust architecture.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Recorded identity, governance and architecture design support professional cloud decisions at three years; the Expert title and hint exceed the evidence for cross-domain seniority or practical implementation assessment.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded identity, governance and infrastructure design support professional Azure architecture responsibility. The senior-scope and expert hint are noted, but a three-year profile and no recorded practical or endorsement do not substantiate expert assurance.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded identity, governance and zero-trust architecture scope supports professional design knowledge at three years. I discount the Expert label because an extensive practical or senior cross-domain assessment is not documented.
